scope: Separate the retained 2004 Life Day quest lineage from the later factional Life Day city event before any selective retirement or restoration work.

eraEvidence.targetBoundary: The retained lineage is explicitly named lifeday04 and consists of five Wookiee conversations, five static-NPC anchor templates, one Mos Espa candy buildout, six forest-planet orb props, two intended anchor-spawner scripts, and original orb/painting/robe rewards.
eraEvidence.laterBoundary: The separate factional layer occupies Doaba Guerfel, Dearic, and Wayfar with 27 buildout rows, Imperial/Rebel token objectives, two 21-row faction vendors, annual rewards, and main Life Day trees.
eraEvidence.admissionFinding: The retained lifeday universe event and four event-gated areas remain, but no buildout/template automatically attaches either original 2004 anchor-spawner script; the target NPC quest chain therefore needs a dedicated admission restoration.

runtimeEvidence.reason: This is a lineage and admission inventory only; it introduces no runtime overlay.
